currentParagraphText: “Are you a member of the Pantheon of Life?” Keerla asked straight up. “Because if you are, I seriously wonder why I never heard about someone like you.”

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Are you a member of the Pantheon of Life?” Keerla asked straight up. “Because if you are, I seriously wonder why I never heard about someone like you.”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I’m not,” Jake answered truthfully. “Just a visitor here to experience the Hunting Grounds and what else the Pantheon of Life has to offer.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “They didn’t leave me much choice,” he shrugged in response, wondering if such actions were looked upon negatively by members of the Pantheon of Life. “I will warn you that the area took some damage during the fight, though, but with how rapidly the jungle recovers, it should be fine.”
